senses.gloss: स्था sthā́, a. (nm. m. n. -s) standing (V.): 🞄often —˚, standing, existing, being.
स्थपनी sthapanī, f. space between eyebrows 🞄(rare).
स्थला sthálā, f. mound (V., rare).

स्थाल sthāla, n. bowl, dish, pot;
 hollow of 🞄a tooth (rare): ī́, f. earthen dish, cooking-pot, 🞄caldron: (sthā́lī) -pāka (AV.) or -pāká, (ŚB.), 🞄m. food cooked in a pot, dish of barley or rice 🞄boiled in milk (often as an offering).
स्थलाय sthalā-ya, den. Ā. become dry land.

स्थलारविन्द sthala‿aravinda, n. land lotus 🞄(Hibiscus mutabilis);
 -ārūḍha, pp. alighted 🞄on the ground (not riding in a charit) or 🞄having ascended an eminence.

स्थलीभू sthalī-bhū, become dry land: pp. 🞄high-lying (country);
 -ya, den. P. regard (the 🞄ocean) as dry land.
स्थलीशायिन् sthalī-śāyin, a. lying or sleeping 🞄on the bare ground.
स्थलेजात sthale-jāta, pp. growing on dry 🞄land: w. padminī, f. land lotus (Hibiscus 🞄mutabilis).

स्थलोत्पलिनी sthala‿utpalinī, f. land lotus 🞄(Hibicus mutabilis);
 -okas, m. animal living 🞄on dry land.
स्थशस् stha-śás, ad. according to its respective 🞄place (RV.¹).

स्थाणव sthāṇav-a, a. [sthāṇu] derived from 🞄trunks of trees;
 -īya, a. belonging to Śiva 🞄(bow).
स्थानेयोग sthāne-yoga, a. standing in the 🞄relation of ‘instead:’ w. ṣaṣṭhī, f. = the 🞄genitive designates that for which something 🞄is substituted.

स्थापत्य sthāpatya, n. [sthapati] office of 🞄gover of a district;
 architecture.
स्थाय sthā-ya, m. receptacle (in jala-).

स्थायिता sthāyi-tā, f. duration;
 -tva, n. id..
स्थायीभू sthāyī-bhū, become lasting or permanent.

स्थायुक sthā-yu-ka, a. [√ sthā] staying, in 🞄(lc.);
 lasting, constant.

स्थाविर sthāvira, a. [sthavira] old, senile;
 🞄n. old age.

स्थासक sthāsa-ka, m. bubble-shaped ornament 🞄on the trappings of a horse;
 m. or n. (?) 🞄figure made with unguents.

स्थास्नु sthā-snu, a. [√ sthā] immovable;
 🞄durable, lasting, permanent.
